contentEn:
Replacing a gas furnace with a heat pump cuts heating costs in half while adding air conditioning for Metro Vancouver summers. BC Hydro offers rebates up to $10,000 for qualifying installations, and Reno Stars handles the full process from equipment selection through permit and rebate application.

How a Heat Pump Works in BC Winters

A heat pump moves heat rather than creating it, like a refrigerator in reverse. Modern cold-climate units extract warmth from outside air even at -10°C. One unit replaces both furnace and air conditioner — for a typical 2,000 sq ft Vancouver home, a properly sized heat pump heats and cools the entire space. Reno Stars installs Mitsubishi, Daikin and Carrier — proven in Lower Mainland conditions.

Heat Pump Installation Cost in BC 2026

Installed costs range $12,000–$20,000 before rebates, depending on home size and ducted vs. ductless choice. BC Hydro rebates cover a significant portion — the amount depends on HSPF rating and whether you are replacing electric baseboard, gas or oil. Switching from gas or oil typically qualifies for the largest incentives.

BC Hydro Rebates: What You Get

The NextGen Cooling Incentive offers $2,000–$10,000 for qualifying heat pump installations. The heat pump must be on the BC Hydro approved product list and installed by a licensed contractor. Rebates are paid directly to the contractor and deducted from your invoice — you do not pay full price upfront and wait for reimbursement. Reno Stars includes free rebate application handling with every installation quote. Federal Canada Green Homes loans provide up to $40,000 in low-interest financing, and Clean BC Better Homes may add further incentives.

Do You Need a Permit for a Heat Pump in BC?

Yes. Heat pump installations involving electrical work require an electrical permit, and if new refrigerant lines are run through walls or floors, a refrigeration permit is also required. For most Lower Mainland single-family homes, permits take 5–10 business days to issue. Reno Stars obtains all required permits as part of standard installation.

Reno Stars Heat Pump Services

Reno Stars has installed heat pumps in homes across Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, Coquitlam, Surrey and surrounding communities. We handle the full scope: equipment recommendation, permit applications, old furnace removal, new system installation, and BC Hydro rebate submission. Every installation includes a full walkthrough of the new system and its operating modes.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can a heat pump work efficiently in cold Vancouver winters?

Modern cold-climate heat pumps maintain heating output down to -15°C to -20°C. Mitsubishi Zubadan and Daikin Altazur are designed specifically for Canadian cold-climate performance.

How long does heat pump installation take?

Complete installation on a single-family home typically takes 2–3 days. Permits need 5–10 business days to be issued before work begins.

Does a heat pump increase home value?

Yes. Heat pump installations typically recoup 80%–100% of their cost in increased home value.

If my home has no ductwork, can I still install a heat pump?

Yes. Multi-zone ductless (split) heat pump systems are often the best choice for older homes, townhomes and apartments without central ducting. Reno Stars installs both ducted and ductless systems.

Ready to install a heat pump in the Lower Mainland? Contact Reno Stars for a free heat pump quote.

用熱泵替換燃氣鍋爐可將家庭供暖費用減半，同時為低陸地區的夏季提供冷氣。BC水電局為符合條件的熱泵安裝提供高達$10,000的補貼——Reno Stars負責從設備選型到許可申請的全部流程。

熱泵如何在BC冬季運作

熱泵不是產生熱量，而是轉移熱量，原理與冰箱相反。即使室外溫度降至-10°C，現代低溫氣候熱泵仍能為房屋供暖。一台設備同時取代爐子和冷氣機——對於典型2,000平方英尺的溫哥華住宅，適當規格的熱泵可為整個房屋供暖和制冷。Reno Stars安裝三菱、大金和開利品牌，這些品牌在低陸氣候條件下性能已獲驗證。

2026年BC熱泵安裝費用

補貼前，全套熱泵系統的安裝費用通常在$12,000至$20,000之間，具體取決於房屋面積及管道或無管道系統的選擇。BC水電局的補貼可抵消大部分費用——金額取決於HSPF供暖能效等級。

BC水電局補貼：您能獲得多少

下一代制冷激勵計劃為熱泵安裝提供$2,000至$10,000的補貼。熱泵必須在BC水電局批准產品清單上，並由持牌承包商安裝。補貼直接支付給承包商並從發票中扣除——您無需先支付全款再等待報銷。

BC熱泵安裝是否需要許可

需要。涉及電氣工作的熱泵安裝需要電氣許可；如果安裝包括穿牆或地板的新制冷劑管路，還需要制冷許可。對於低陸大多數單戶住宅，許可流程需要5至10個工作日。Reno Stars作為標準安裝服務的一部分獲取所有必要許可。

Reno Stars的熱泵安裝服務

Reno Stars已在溫哥華、列治文、本拿比、科奎爾蘭、素里及周邊社區的住宅中安裝了熱泵。我們處理全部工作範圍：設備推薦、許可申請、舊爐子拆除、新設備安裝及BC水電局補貼提交。

想在低陸地區安裝熱泵？聯繫Reno Stars獲取免費熱泵報價。
